name: Aster USDF
oneLiner: USDF is Aster's delta-neutral synthetic dollar on BSC, minted 1:1 against USDT; yields from BTC/ETH funding-rate arbitrage via Ceffu MirrorX on Binance.
collateral: USDT held by custodian Ceffu; deployed in delta-neutral strategies (long spot + short perpetuals) executed via Ceffu MirrorX on Binance
pegMechanism: Minted against USDT at a 1:1 reference; issuer-documented redemption charges 0.1% and takes 1-2 days for standard amounts or up to 7 days for large amounts. Yield accrues to asUSDF from delta-neutral positions on Binance through Ceffu MirrorX.

dependencyReview.rationale: USDF is minted from USDT at the protocol's 1:1 reference and redeemed to USDT after the issuer-documented 0.1% redemption fee. USDT supplies both the holder exit asset and the reference unit, while USDF's actively managed backing and local controls remain distinct rather than inheriting USDT as a mechanically identical wrapper claim. The issuer FAQ gives 1-2 days processing for standard amounts and up to 7 days for large amounts.

relationships.reason: USDT is the protocol's redemption output for USDF at a 1:1 reference before the issuer-documented 0.1% redemption fee.
USDT is the protocol's 1:1 reference unit for USDF mint and redemption accounting.
